turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of an elderly man, approximately seventy, in a tightly framed, vertical chest-up portrait. His head is nearly upright, turned slightly toward the viewer’s right, with dark, reflective eyes looking directly at the camera. His expression is quiet, thoughtful, and unsmiling. He has a broad, elongated oval face, a high forehead crossed by several deep horizontal furrows, bushy grey eyebrows, hooded eyes with pronounced lower-lid bags, crow’s-feet, and finely creased cheeks. A long, prominent nose has a rounded, fleshy tip and gently flared nostrils. His closed mouth is partly concealed beneath a thick, bristly, silver-white moustache. Show thin lips, a rounded chin, a softly squared jaw, and pale, naturally weathered skin with subtle mottling and deep nasolabial folds; otherwise clean-shaven. Abundant, unruly white hair rises high above the forehead and spreads outward around the ears in fluffy, wavy wisps, swept backward without a definite part. Dress him in a mid-twentieth-century, coarse grey-brown wool jacket with broad overlapping collar points and a dark central button. Illuminate from upper left with moderately soft, directional light, leaving deeper shadows on the opposite cheek. Use a plain, blurred charcoal background, lighter at left. Translate the archival monochrome appearance into restrained natural colour, retaining fine grain, crisp facial detail, and tactile fabric texture.
